title: Conditioning section token mass reduces false rejections in shuffled layouts and leaves an ordered-layout failure
statement: I calibrated exact-token-mass and one-percentage-point mass-bin page-label nulls on 20 paired backgrounds for each of three orders at 31, 62 and 124 fixed pages. The exact-mass test cannot attain alpha 0.05 in any of the 60 backgrounds at 31 pages. At 124 pages in the two fresh shuffled orders, cyclic testing rejected 18/20 and 13/20 unplanted samples. The fixed-bin test rejected 0/19 and 1/20 among samples with enough assignments, and detected a 10% plant in 19/19 and 20/20. On the same pages in manuscript order, cyclic testing rejected 0/20 unplanted samples; exact mass rejected 11/20 and fixed bins rejected 15/19. The matched 10% placebos have comparable patterns. Matching eligible token masses therefore helps on these shuffled orders but does not remove the spurious section signal on manuscript-order backgrounds with local word memory. The calibration retains abstentions separately from nonrejections and compares both 0.05 and 0.01 thresholds.
check: Freeze a comparison that conditions both eligible paragraph token mass and local text dependence. Compare mass-bin-conditioned cyclic rotations with block-aware replacements that preserve page sequences inside contiguous runs. Declare attainable-rank support before computing statistics, and keep unmatched results as abstentions. Check false rejections and power with new stationary-table rolling-memory backgrounds, matched placebos, and multiple fixed layouts at the same page count.
method: Reuse the frozen public training-page reservation and stationary transition tables with rolling word memory. Use one shared generated line stream with an independent opener-style draw. At each fixed page count preserve the page set and compare the manuscript order and two newly seeded page shuffles. The observed selection of paragraph slots is held fixed.

For Null A, group pages by exactly equal selected paragraph word counts and uniformly permute labels only inside each group. Eligible section token totals and section page counts stay exactly equal. For Null B, sort pages by selected paragraph counts and folio identity and form consecutive groups of eight, retaining the final shorter block. Propose independent uniform label permutations inside groups and retain only assignments with the same global vector of integer percentage bins: floor(100 times section words divided by total selected words). The bins are anchored at zero and the label counts within each group are fixed. This admits fewer than one percentage point of change for each section and can still mean a substantial relative difference for a small section.

Enumerate the ambient assignments exactly when there are at most 12,000, and otherwise inspect up to 12,000 uniform proposals. Keep up to 199 distinct nonidentity assignments, with a uniform subset when enumerated support is larger. Report exact conditioned support when known and retained support otherwise. Count ties conservatively, include the identity in the denominator and require at least 19 or 99 alternatives for the two alpha levels.

For each background use the same assignments for the unplanted text and the four original doses of length-preserving plant and placebo. A placebo retains the chosen positions, original lengths and multiset of markers within each length group. Compare against the 199 all-token shuffles, 199 intact-page label shuffles, and all cyclic offsets from P-J-017.

Conditional randomization presumes exchangeable assignments given the declared strata and mass bins. It does not preserve local dependence or section runs. Some outcomes are cap-limited rather than proven to have small exact support. Conditional rejection denominators omit abstentions and are never treated as 20 when a design is unsupported. The layouts and interventions reuse paired backgrounds, so counts across layouts are not independent.

plan.page_count_rank_tie_break: original numeric folio order within the sampled layout
plan.notes: Use a uniform permutation of labels within each frozen block. Condition approximate draws on the full vector of fixed bins, not a distance around the current observed count.

"""Summarize size-conditioned power and eligibility at 5% and 1%."""

from collections import defaultdict
import json
from math import sqrt
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import median


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ORDER = ["manuscript", "shuffle-49311", "shuffle-69329"]
NULLS = ["token", "page", "cyclic", "exact token mass", "one-percentage-point bins"]


def records():
    data = [
        json.loads(line)
        for file in ("pilot.jsonl", "remaining.jsonl")
        for line in (ROOT / file).read_text().splitlines()
    ]
    cases = [row for item in data for row in item["cases"]]
    support = [row for item in data for row in item["support"]]
    assert len(data) == 20 and len(cases) == 1620 and len(support) == 180
    assert len({tuple(row[:5]) for row in cases}) == len(cases)
    assert all(row[3]["largest_section_word_count_shift"] == 0 for row in support)
    return cases, support


def wilson(hits, n):
    if not n:
        return None
    z = 1.959964
    p = hits / n
    d = 1 + z*z/n
    center = (p + z*z/(2*n))/d
    half = z*sqrt(p*(1-p)/n + z*z/(4*n*n))/d
    return [round(max(0, center-half), 4), round(min(1, center+half), 4)]


def summarize(cases):
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for row in cases:
        groups[tuple(row[1:5])].append(row)
    summary = []
    for design, rows in sorted(groups.items()):
        size, _, _, _ = design
        by_test = []
        for index, test in enumerate(NULLS):
            ranks = [row[6 + index] for row in rows]
            denominators = [([200, 200, size, row[11]+1, row[12]+1][index]) for row in rows]
            results = [test, [min(denominators), median(denominators), max(denominators)]]
            for cutoff in (20, 100):
                can_reject = sum(m >= cutoff for m in denominators)
                rejects = sum(rank * cutoff <= m for rank, m in zip(ranks, denominators, strict=True))
                results.append([can_reject, rejects, wilson(rejects, can_reject)])
            by_test.append(results)
        summary.append({"design": design, "tests": by_test})
    return summary


def compact_cases(cases):
    return [
        [seed, size, ORDER.index(order), ("base", "plant", "placebo").index(case), dose, *observations]
        for seed, size, order, case, dose, *observations in cases
    ]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    cases, _ = records()
    (ROOT / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summarize(cases), indent=2) + "\n")
